lyrics.label: Verse 1
lines: As I survey the ground for ants
Looking for a place to sit and read

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lines: I'm reminded of the streets of my hometown How
They're much like this concrete
It's warm beneath my feet

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lines: Now I'm all wrapped up in my mother's face
With a touch of my father
Just up around the eyes
And the sound of my brother's laugh
More wraps up in what binds our ever-destined lives

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lines: But if I must go
Things I trust will be better off without me
But I don't want to know
Cause life is better off a mystery
So keep on coming with these lines on the road
And keep me responsible,
Be it a light or heavy load
Keep me guessing with these blessings in disguise

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lines: I'll walk grace like feet and faith like eyes
My hometown weather is on TV
And I imagine the lives of the people living there

lyrics.label: Tag
lines: And I'm curious if they imagine me

lyrics.label: Verse 6
lines: They just want to leave
I wish that I could stay

lyrics.label: Tag
lines: I get turned around

lyrics.label: Verse 7
lines: And I mistake my happiness for blessing
And I'm blessed as the poor
Still I judge success by how I'm dressing
So keep on coming with these lines on the road
And keeping me responsible,
Be it a light or heavy load
Keep me guessing with these blessings in disguise
And I'll walk and grace my feet and faith my eyes

lyrics.label: Verse 8
lines: La la la la la la So
I'll sing a song of my hometown

lyrics.label: Tag
lines: I'll breathe the air and I'll walk the streets

lyrics.label: Verse 9
lines: And maybe find a place to sit and breathe
But the ants are a welcome company
Keep welcoming the lions on the road
And keeping me responsible
Being light on heavy load
Keep me guessing with these blessings in disguise
I'll walk and grace my feet and faith my eyes
